summary: Lumen Technologies, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing that its subsidiary Qwest Corporation commenced exchange offers for its 6.5% Notes due 2056 and 6.75% Notes due 2057 (Old Qwest Notes) for new notes of the same maturities and coupons (New Qwest Notes), fully guaranteed by Lumen. Concurrently, consents are solicited for proposed indenture amendments. The exchange is governed by a Form S-4 prospectus. No pricing premium, close date, or advisors were disclosed. Structural note: the exchange removes existing covenants via consent solicitation in a liability-management transaction. Watch for minimum tender conditions and participation thresholds.
